description: Implements the specified NDCG-weighted LambdaRank specialization: a per-query sum of base-2 pairwise logistic losses weighted by hard score-rank swap deltas. The repair specification attributes gains and normalization to Wang et al. §3.3 Eq. (4), swap weighting and pair loss to §3.4 Eqs. (5)-(6), and the LambdaRank M-step to §4.3 Eq. (11) (https://doi.org/10.1145/3269206.3271784). The local paper text was unavailable, so correspondence with those equations remains unverified.

examples.title: Train a shared document scorer with LambdaLoss

name: LambdaLoss: NDCG-weighted LambdaRank specialization

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported parameter names passed through **params raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None; ignored-document semantics are unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point scores with shape [N] for one query or [B, N] for equal-length query batches; N and B must be positive
parameters.reduction: 'none' returns one unnormalized pair sum per query, 'mean' averages query losses, or 'sum' adds them (default 'mean')
parameters.sigma: finite positive real slope for the pairwise logistic term (default 1.0)
parameters.targets: finite nonnegative numeric relevance labels matching the score shape and device
